title: ISEMBYLD FDA: 34% Motor Gain, Age 2+
summary:
FDA approved ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) on 11 September 2026 as the first muscle-targeted therapy for spinal muscular atrophy in patients 2 years and older who already take an SMN2-directed drug. In SAPPHIRE, 34.2% of ISEMBYLD patients had a clinically meaningful motor-function gain versus 13.5% on placebo. The labeled dose is 10 mg/kg intravenously every four weeks.
